examples.en: Our company is trying to internationalize its services.
Universities are internationalizing by teaching classes in English.
It takes time to internationalize the market.
Opinions came up about internationalizing the city.
Sales went up after the brand went international.
If you internationalize a school, the number of international students grows.

explain: 회사, 학교, 도시처럼 하나를 해외 사람들도 이용할 수 있게 바꾼다는 느낌으로 써요. '세계화하다'와 가까워요. 스스로 그렇게 바뀌는 상황에는 '국제화되다'를 써요.

phrases.en: These days our neighborhood has become much more international.
phrases.nuance_ko: '국제화하다'는 사람이 바꾸는 것이고 '국제화되다'는 저절로 바뀌는 것이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: 국제화하다 is done on purpose; 국제화되다 means it happens to something.

phrases.example: 그 회사는 한국 음식을 세계화하고 있어요.
phrases.en: That company is taking Korean food global.
phrases.nuance_ko: '국제화하다'와 비슷하고 전 세계로 퍼뜨린다는 느낌이 더 커요.
phrases.nuance_en: Close to 국제화하다, with a stronger sense of spreading worldwide.

phrases.en: To internationalize a school, foreign-language classes are needed.
phrases.nuance_ko: 목적이나 조건을 말할 때 연결해서 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A connected form for stating a goal or condition.

explain_en: It is used for changing something like a company, school or city so people abroad can also use it. It is close to '세계화하다'. When something changes that way on its own, use '국제화되다'.

examples.en: The court invalidated that contract.
The new law nullifies the earlier decision.
The company announced that it would void the event win.
Some people suggested invalidating the vote.

examples.ko: 이미 낸 서류를 무효화하려면 어떻게 해야 해요?
examples.en: What should I do to void the documents I already submitted?

examples.ko: 한 번의 실수가 그동안의 노력을 무효화하지는 않아요.
examples.en: One mistake doesn't wipe out all the effort until now.

explain: '효력을 없애다'라는 뜻의 격식 있는 말이라서 계약, 투표, 결정, 규정처럼 공식적인 일에 주로 써요. 일상 대화에서는 '취소하다', '없던 일로 하다'를 더 많이 말해요. 결과를 말할 때는 '무효가 되다'도 자주 써요.

phrases.nuance_en: The passive form, used to describe the result.

phrases.example: 규칙을 어기면 시험 결과가 무효가 돼요.
phrases.en: If you break the rules, the test result becomes invalid.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일상에서 더 쉽게 쓸 수 있는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An easier phrase for everyday use.

phrases.nuance_ko: 일상 대화에서 더 자주 쓰고 덜 딱딱해요.
phrases.nuance_en: More common in daily talk and less formal.

explain_en: It is a formal word for taking away something's effect, so it is mostly used for official matters like contracts, votes, decisions and rules. In daily talk people more often say '취소하다' or '없던 일로 하다'. To describe the result, '무효가 되다' is also common.

examples.en: That region commercialized its tourist spots quickly.

examples.ko: 예술을 너무 상업화하면 본질을 잃을 수 있어요.
examples.en: If you commercialize art too much, it can lose its essence.
They founded a company to commercialize the research results.
Residents object, saying the traditional festival is being commercialized.

examples.ko: 기술을 상업화해서 돈을 벌기까지 오래 걸려요.
examples.en: It takes a long time to commercialize a technology and earn money.
This technology is scheduled to be commercialized next year.

explain: 축제나 예술에 쓰면 돈벌이에 치우친다는 비판이 담겨요. 기술이나 연구 결과에 쓰면 제품으로 만들어 판다는 중립적인 말이에요. 비슷한 '상품화하다'는 어떤 것을 상품으로 만든다는 뜻이라 비판의 느낌이 약해요.

phrases.example: 이 전통 시장은 점점 상업화되고 있어요.
phrases.en: This traditional market is becoming more and more commercialized.
phrases.nuance_ko: 스스로 하는 일이 아니라 상황이 그렇게 변하는 것을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when things change this way rather than someone doing it on purpose.

phrases.example: 이 마을은 관광지를 상업화하지 않아서 조용해요.
phrases.en: This village hasn't commercialized its tourist spot, so it's quiet.
phrases.nuance_en: Means keeping something from being turned into a money-maker.

phrases.example: 회사가 그 기술을 상품화해서 팔기 시작했어요.
phrases.en: The company turned that technology into a product and began selling it.
phrases.nuance_ko: 비판의 느낌이 약하고 제품으로 만든다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Has less criticism; means turning something into a product.

explain_en: Used for a festival or art, it carries criticism that money has taken over. Used for a technology or research result, it neutrally means turning it into a product to sell. The similar '상품화하다' just means making something into a product, so it sounds less critical.

examples.ko: 외래 종교가 이 나라에서 토착화 과정을 거쳤어요.
examples.en: The foreign religion went through a process of localization in this country.
It takes time for a new system to take root.

examples.ko: 커피 문화의 토착화가 빠르게 진행되고 있어요.
examples.en: The localization of coffee culture is progressing fast.
The settling in of alien species affects the ecosystem.
Food also changes in taste once it becomes localized.
I gave a presentation on the localization of Christianity.

explain: 밖에서 들어온 문화, 종교, 제도, 생물이 그곳에 자리 잡아 그 땅의 것이 되는 과정을 말해요. 뉴스나 발표에서 쓰는 말이고, 일상에서는 '자리를 잡다'라고 많이 해요. 회사가 상품을 현지에 맞게 바꾸는 건 '현지화'라고 해요.

phrases.en: Coffee culture has taken root in Korea.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 것이 그 땅에 자리 잡을 때 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when something takes root in a place.

phrases.en: That brand succeeded in taking root locally.
phrases.nuance_ko: 외국에서 온 것이 잘 자리 잡았을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when something from abroad settled in well.

phrases.en: This company sells its products after adapting them to the local market.
phrases.nuance_ko: 회사가 상품을 현지에 맞게 바꾸는 것은 '현지화'라고 해요.
phrases.nuance_en: When a company adapts a product to the local market, it is called 현지화.

explain_en: It refers to the process in which something from outside, such as a culture, religion, system, or species, settles in and becomes part of the place. It is a word for news and presentations; in daily talk people often say '자리를 잡다'. When a company adapts a product to a local market, people say '현지화'.

examples.en: Opinions are divided on equalizing high schools.

examples.ko: 학교 평준화 정책 이후 입시가 바뀌었어요.
examples.en: Admissions changed after the school equalization policy.

examples.ko: 기술 평준화 때문에 제품 차이가 줄었어요.
examples.en: Because technology has leveled out, differences between products have shrunk.

examples.ko: 요즘은 팀 간 전력의 평준화가 뚜렷해요.
examples.en: These days the leveling of strength between teams is clear.

examples.ko: 평준화를 찬성하는 사람도 반대하는 사람도 있어요.
examples.en: Some people favor equalization and some oppose it.

examples.ko: 지역 간 평준화는 쉬운 일이 아니에요.
examples.en: Equalizing regions is not an easy task.

explain: 한국에서는 '고교 평준화'라는 말로 교육 뉴스에 많이 나와요. 격차가 줄어 비슷해진다는 뜻으로 기술, 실력, 임금에도 써요. 문장에서는 '평준화되다'와 '평준화하다'로도 쓰여요.

phrases.en: The technology levels of the two companies have become equalized.
phrases.nuance_en: Suggests a gap has narrowed and things have become similar.

phrases.en: Many people also support the equalization policy.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing frequently found in education news.

phrases.example: 고교 평준화 지역에서는 추첨으로 학교가 정해져요.
phrases.en: In areas with high school equalization, schools are assigned by lottery.
phrases.nuance_ko: 한국 교육 제도를 말할 때 꼭 나오는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A key term when discussing the Korean education system.

explain_en: In Korea it appears often in education news as '고교 평준화' (high school equalization). It is also used for technology, skill and wages when gaps shrink and things become similar. In sentences it also appears as '평준화되다' and '평준화하다'.
